rules.statement: Under section 20 of the Jaffna Matrimonial Rights and Inheritance Ordinance, title to half of the diatheddam property acquired by a husband vested in his wife immediately upon the acquisition of the property before it was amended on 3rd July, 1947. This vesting did not affect the husband's right to sell or mortgage the property.
rules.supporting_quote: "Such immediate vesting of title in the wife was not inconsistent with the husband's right to sell or mortgage the property."
